experiment_a_chemical_classifier.task: Molecular SMILES classification to Insecticide vs Fungicide vs Herbicide
experiment_a_chemical_classifier.utility_assessment: Valuable for secondary chemical property lookup and validation of active ingredients extracted by OCR/Gemma 4; does not perform computer vision.

experiment_b_arabic_ocr.utility_assessment: Successfully trained character classifier on Arabic alphabet; completely irrelevant to English, Hindi, and Marathi pesticide packaging.

experiment_c_crop_tile_autoencoder.task: 16x16 Aerial Drone Terrain Patch Reconstruction (Crop Plants vs Weeds)
experiment_c_crop_tile_autoencoder.utility_assessment: Reconstructs agricultural field soil and vegetation; 'crop' represents field plants, not packaging image cropping.

experiment_d_pesticide_detector_feasibil.reason: Absence of real packaging photos and bounding box annotations across all three repositories.
experiment_d_pesticide_detector_feasibil.deliverable: Created specification template experiments/annotation_spec_yolo.json for future packaging collection.

experiment_e_detector_comparison.finding: Contour binarization improves packaging recall to 100% and yields dynamic bounding box localization, while edge density provides camera stability scoring.

experiment_f_ocr_comparison.cloud_gemma4_blocker: Zero pre-paid credits on Hugging Face Inference Router account.
